name: codex-theme-studio
description: Design, convert, preview, and save Codex CLI and Claude Code themes inside the terminal.

interface.shortDescription: Design Codex and Claude Code themes.
interface.longDescription: Launches a terminal-native theme studio with authentic clickable Codex and Claude previews, direct colour lists, keyboard and mouse editing, two-way conversion, and validated native-store saving. It opens in a separate window by default, with tab and restoring-overlay options.
defaultPrompt: Help me design a Codex theme.
Help me design a Claude Code theme.
